text:
maya: Heads up — sudden spike in fncall validation rejects in prod canary (eu-west-1). Reject rate went from ~0.2% to ~1.1% in the last 10m. Sample error from the adapter:
```
{
  \"error\": \"validation_error\",
  \"message\": \"expected object, got array\",
  \"validator\": \"strict-validate-v2\",
  \"request_snippet\": \"[\\\"item\\\"]\"
}
```
Can we triage? cc @derek @sophia

Derek: On it. Which rollout is active for strict-validate-v2? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout info — feature=strict-validate-v2, region=eu-west-1, rollout_pct=12, status=running

sophia: Quick observation — telemetry for these events often misses `route_id`. We're sampling out route tags when validation happens early. That makes it hard to map rejects to a customer route/policy.

alex: Could be a quota/backpressure interaction too. If validator rejects, requests drop to degen route which increments a different quota counter. Ops + billing will be confused if we don't surface that. :thinking_face:

maya: Two short-term options: 1) toggle strict-validate-v2 off for the canary; 2) switch it to soft-fail so validator logs the error but lets the request continue (with a tag). I lean soft-fail so we keep telemetry. Any objections?

Derek: I prefer soft-fail for now. New tag: `VALIDATION_SOFTFALLBACK`. Also: enrich validation events with `route_id`, `model_variant`, and `validator_version`. Increase sampling of full-payload captures to 5% for reject events so we can debug root cause.

Sophia: I'll open a telemetry PR. Also propose a quick dashboard: "fncall reject rate by error_code" + heatmap for `route_id`. Ops should be able to filter by rollout tag and region.

Alex: We should normalize error codes into a small enum: INVALID_SHAPE, PARTIAL_PARSE, TRUNCATION, OTHER. Right now we just log `validation_error` which is too noisy.

Maya: Action list: Derek flips soft-fail toggle, Sophia adds telemetry + alert, Alex designs dashboard panel. Timeline: toggle in ~10m, telemetry change within 2h, dashboard mock by EOD. Derek — can you take the toggle?

Derek: Assigned. I'll flip strict-validate-v2 -> soft-fail and document rollback steps. Will annotate the canary with `soft-validate-v2=true` and publish a note to the console rollout feed.

deploy-bot: Canary update — strict-validate-v2 set to SOFT-FAIL, rollout_pct reduced to 5% for eu-west-1. Change propagated.

Maya: Observability ask — add an alert to avoid silent rejections: trigger if reject_rate > 0.5% (absolute) OR rejects > 300/min. Alert should page #eng-oncall and include top 10 `route_id`s.

Sophia: Opening PR now for telemetry + alert (PR: https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-123) — will include event schema and sampling knobs.

Alex: One more UX question: when soft-fail occurs, do we route to the degen fallback or to a model-variant fallback? We need deterministic behaviour per-account.

Derek: Current policy remains: soft-fail -> degen route (free-form LLM). We can add a console toggle for per-account policy later to prefer explicit error vs variant-fallback. That will be a follow-up.

Maya: Ok keep degen route for now. Create ticket to add per-account policy and console toggle. Ticket INF-4821.

Sophia: Adding INF-4821 and linking PR. Will include dashboard wireframe in ticket.

Maya: Thanks — thumbs up. Keep updates in INF-4821, closing this thread for now. :thumbsup:
